record_title: Odd-power Weingarten surfaces force nonzero umbilics in every positive-curvature component
limitations: The theorem extends the componentwise nonzero-umbilic mechanism from the known cubic case to odd powers p>=5, but it does not classify the resulting surfaces, does not treat even exponents, and retains C3 regularity. Higher odd-power rotational examples were already known. A 1959 historical analytic genus-zero theorem of Voss was not inspected in full, and the motivating cubic preprint is very recent, so differently phrased or later parallel coverage remains a residual originality risk.
